title: Missing 411: national park disappearances tied to UFO sightings and hidden FBI files

plain: A writer and researcher, Jason Jorjani, relays the work of a man he names as David Pitus, who wrote a book series called Missing 411 about people who vanished in US national parks. According to Jorjani, Pitus found that in the same areas where people went missing, people also reported seeing UFOs, a link explored in a related work called Closer Encounters. If true, it would tie unexplained disappearances to UFO activity.
